method: Claude in Chrome driven by an agent through the same local fixture site as bench.py. Wall time is the gap between two `date +%s%N` stamps around each run, so it includes the agent's own model round trips. Screenshot path with 0.5 scale. Success verified with get_page_text.

text_path_trials.note: click reported success, page stayed on the home page; one get_page_text call failed because the extension disconnected
click reported success, page stayed on the home page after two further reads

token_estimates.basis: images: width x height / 750; text: characters / 4. Estimates, not billing data. They exclude the agent's own output tokens and the re-reading of earlier turns.
